sources.title: Findmypast: Bessie Glasgow, baptism 21 April 1682, father William; OPR 689/20 item 1 p.39
Findmypast: John Glasgow, baptism 29 November 1702, father William; OPR 689/20 item 1
Findmypast: William Glasgow, baptism 22 April 1705, father William; OPR 689/20 item 1
FamilySearch VQ4K-ZQN: William in Bessie’s 1682 entry; child link VQ4K-ZQF; father only
FamilySearch VQ4K-FY9: William Glasgou, christened 22 April 1705; father William, no mother

finding: The FamilySearch citations previously used to say William and Ann McCook were both recorded as parents were also inspected. VQ4K-ZQN is the father entry for Bessie, linked to child VQ4K-ZQF; it names William only. VQ4K-FY9 records the child William Glasgou and his father William, without a mother. Both display “Image Unavailable”. These indexes therefore do not establish Ann’s maternity or the couple’s marriage. The older claim that those citations name Ann is superseded; the earlier attached family and all citations remain available for comparison. An omitted mother is not evidence excluding Ann.
limits: Retain Ann McCook’s existing spouse and maternal attachments as unproved tree claims; no person is detached or redated. The three same-name father entries do not alone establish one continuous 1682–1705 household. They supply no bridge to the older John Glasgow-3610’s Easter Newtoun household, so the selected John-to-William father hypothesis remains uncertain at 24%. The 1702 transcript supports 29 November as its baptism date, but does not resolve John-1544’s separate before-11-November field; no vital field is changed. This is a source-scope correction, not a new baptism discovery, father selection, confidence upgrade or component join.
scope: Findmypast Bessie1682±2,John1702±2,William1705±2,surnameGlasgow,locationKirknewton; five source pages inspected. Search results were not treated as event coverage.
